{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|arg= global

|gr1= Unit Control

|descr= Returns the stance of the given unit.

|s1= [[stance]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[String]] - can be:
* {{hl|"STAND"}}
* {{hl|"CROUCH"}}
* {{hl|"PRONE"}}
* {{hl|"UNDEFINED"}} (for example, swimming)
* {{hl|""}} (on non-person [[Object|object]])

|x1= <sqf>if (stance player == "STAND") then { hint "I am standing!" };</sqf>

}}
